'''''Relentless''''' was a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that was part of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The ''Relentless'' was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Meeba (Republic Navy)|Meeba]] and during the conflict, it was assigned to serve as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Strike Force Cularin]]. It flew to the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]] with the rest of the strike force and participated in a [[Mission to the Ando system|mission]] to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] base that had been set up there.

The [[Warship/Legends|warship]] later traveled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to pick up [[Osten Dal'Nay]], [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] and [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]], to take them to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. It traveled there as the flagship of a fleet of twelve ships and on arrival in the system, it participated in the [[Battle of Cularin (21 BBY)|Battle of Cularin]].
